name: repple-app
description: Repple — white-label fitness platform (Expo + Supabase). Production scaffold.

scripts.preflight: npm run typecheck && npm run test:zones && npm run db:check && npm run check:native && npm run check:reads && npm run check:portal && npm run check:schema && npm run check:bundle
scripts.test:zones: TZ=America/Los_Angeles npm run test && TZ=Pacific/Auckland npm run test && TZ=Asia/Dubai npm run test

//deferred-native-deps: Added at the dev-build/EAS stage (they require native code and do NOT run in Expo Go): @stripe/stripe-react-native
//native-deps-in-tree: Already installed and native, so a dev build is required from here on — Expo Go will not run the app: expo-video (exercise demos play inline; the alternative was Linking.openURL, which sends a client out of the app mid-session and is what lost their typed sets).
//react-native-health-patch: react-native-health 1.19.0 (last published Oct 2024, unmaintained) calls [self.callableJSModules setBridge:] in emitEventInternal, a selector RCTCallableJSModules no longer exposes in React Native 0.86 — so every iOS build under Expo SDK 57 failed to compile. The call is vestigial: RCTEventEmitter's own sendEventWithName:body: does not need the bridge set by hand. patches/ removes that one line and postinstall reapplies it, including on the EAS build server. Remove both if the package ever ships a fix.
